description: relay_client.rs: enforce_for_delivery(rcpt_domain: &str, peer_host: &str, peer_tls: bool). At call sites (relay_client.rs:389) the caller passes peer.tls directly. A bool param named 'peer_tls' is not self-documenting at the call site — enforce_for_delivery(domain, host, true) is ambiguous without reading the signature. A PeerTlsStatus { Tls, Plain } enum or a TlsRequired(bool) newtype would make it clear at every call site. Small change, real readability improvement for future maintainers.
title: enforce_for_delivery takes bool peer_tls — should be a two-variant enum
